x.text: Arjun Mehta from my Builders community is building a gym-log app: pick a creator program, log a set in two taps, and it tells you when to add weight. He needs a designer and an iOS developer. Want in?

instagram.text:
Small first versions are how big things start.

Arjun Mehta from my Builders community is building a gym-log app for people who follow creator programs. You pick a program, log each set in two taps, and the app tells you when it's time to add weight.

He has a working prototype and 12 friends are already testing it. Now he's forming a team and needs a designer and an iOS developer who knows HealthKit.

This is exactly the kind of tool I want to exist: simple, honest, and built to help you train consistently.

If that's you, or you just want to try it, tap the link in bio and say hi.

linkedin.text:
One of my favourite things about this community: people don't just talk about ideas, they build them.

Arjun Mehta, from the Builders community in my space, is making a gym-log app for people who follow creator training programs. The idea is simple. Pick a program, log a set in two taps, and the app tells you when to add weight.

He already has a working React Native prototype, and 12 friends are testing it. The project is now forming a team, and two roles are open: a designer and an iOS developer, ideally someone who knows HealthKit.

I back tools that help people train consistently, and this is one of them.

Know someone who should be on this team? Send them the link or tag them below.
